# 3aash Ya Wa7sh (عاش يا وحش)

> 3aash Ya Wa7sh is a free community initiative in Egypt, founded by Dr. Ahmed Amrousy — an engineer and endurance athlete, not a coach. It helps people who do not exercise take their first steps towards a regularly active life. You fill in a 6-step form, and professional coaches write an exercise program around your goal, schedule and health. You track your sessions in your account on the site, and when you are ready you can find a race or sports challenge in Egypt and the Gulf on Find Your Challenge.

Arabic name: عاش يا وحش. English name: 3aash Ya Wa7sh. Website: https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/ (Arabic is the main language; every public page also has an English version).

## Key facts
- A free community initiative in Egypt — not a gym or a coaching business.
- Built for complete beginners, and open to anyone aged 12 and up.
- Exercise programs are written by professional coaches — never generated automatically.
- The founder, Dr. Ahmed Amrousy, is an engineer and endurance athlete, not a coach.
- Find Your Challenge lists races and sports events in Egypt and the Gulf, with their official links.
- Founder: Dr. Ahmed Amrousy (أحمد عمروسي) — Engineer and endurance athlete: triathlete, marathoner and half-Ironman finisher. He knows what it takes to train around a full-time career and real responsibilities — and that is what the whole idea is built on.
- Coaching: Your program is designed and followed up by professional coaches, built around your goal, your schedule and your health — not a template handed to everyone.
- Who can join: Anyone aged 12 and up, at any level. Under 18s need a guardian’s name and consent.
- Safety: Health safety questions before any program, and your doctor’s OK first if anything comes up. No hormones or steroids — ever.
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/3aashyawa7sh
- 3aash Ya Wa7sh does not organise the races it lists and does not sell tickets; registration is always on the organiser's own website.

## Main pages
- [Home and sign-up form](https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/en.html): what the initiative is, how it works, common questions. Arabic: https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/
- [Find Your Challenge](https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/events-en.html): races and sports events in Egypt and the Gulf, with dates, prices and official links. Arabic: https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/events.html
- [Privacy policy](https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/privacy-en.html). Arabic: https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/privacy.html

## Guides
- [How to start exercising from zero](https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/start-exercising-en.html): Never trained, or stopped years ago? Start with 15–20 minutes of brisk walking three times a week and build slowly. A 4-week plan, home strength moves, and when to ask your doctor. Arabic: https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/start-exercising.html
- [Your first 5K: a beginner running plan](https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/first-5k-en.html): From walking to running 5 km non-stop in about 8 weeks: three run-walk sessions a week. The week-by-week plan, shoes and heat, and how to choose your first 5K race in Egypt. Arabic: https://ahmedamrousy.com/3aash-ya-wa7sh/first-5k.html
